lee: RFC follow-up: operator cutover playbook for moving custs from shared peering -> per-tenant ephemeral relays. goals: preserve client src IP when possible, avoid lease exhaustion on spikes, fast rollback. need concise checklist + exact operator cmds.

rachel: +1. include preflight that checks snat policy and long-lived sessions, and require --ticket for all ops.

lee: concise runbook: 1) preflight check 2) reserve leases 3) warm relay 4) shadow small % 5) promote w/ sticky leases 6) monitor + reclaim. reversible at each step.

kai: preflight examples:
```bash
opsctl customer inspect --customer=cust-901 --fields=snat_policy,active_sessions --ticket=INC-2026-1100
```

rachel: reserve leases:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-901","count":25,"region":"us-east-1","purpose":"cutover-2026-03"}'
```

kai: warm probe + create relay:
```bash
opsctl relay create --name=rel-use1-07 --region=us-east-1 --customer=cust-901 --ticket=INC-2026-1100
opsctl relay probe --relay=rel-use1-07 --shots=100
```

ops-bot: INFO: probe_results=98/100, relay.health=OK.

lee: shadow 3% traffic:
```bash
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-901 --target=rel-use1-07 --sample=3 --ticket=INC-2026-1100
```

kai: monitor metrics for 10-15m: egress.lease_pool_available, relay.health, cp.api_latency, tcp.session_abort_rate. if lease_pool_available < 12% -> autoscale + reduce sample.

rachel: promote when stable (sticky-ttl note):
- default sticky-ttl=600s for requesty apps
- use sticky-ttl=1800s for websocket-ish flows (enable lease-refresh if > 600s)

promotion command:
```bash
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-901 --target=rel-use1-07 --sticky-ttl=1800 --ticket=INC-2026-1100
```

kai: lease-refresh example (relay -> operator):
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN" -d '{"lease_id":"lease-xyz","extend_seconds":1800}'
```

lee: fast rollback (if problems):
1) `opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-901 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-1100`
2) scale controllers: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/egress-operator --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy egress-operator -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')+3))`
3) cordon unhealthy relay and re-run warm-up for replacement.

rachel: automation rules: lease_pool_available < 12% -> trigger autoscale and reduce sampling to 0-1%. eviction policy: evict non-sticky/short TTL leases first.

ops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-901 at 11% (threshold 12%). INCIDENT INC-2026-1100 created.

lee: action items: kai -> add lease-refresh endpoint + tests; rachel -> opsctl preflight validator; i'll draft the full playbook and attach exact cmds to the RFC. keep replies short.
